name: sdd-pipeline
description: Spec-Driven Development pipeline for AI coding agents.

plugins.name: sdd-pipeline
plugins.description: A full delivery team as gated, traceable skills: discovery → PRD → diagrams → FSD → architecture → security (SSDLC) → tiered backlog → test plan → implement → infra → verify (≥80% coverage, code-review) → ship. Autopilot & copilot modes; SSOT/DRY/YAGNI code bar. Stack-neutral; friendly to developers and non-developers.
